frontmatter.description: Core architectural boundaries, single-source-of-truth persona models, and multi-agent harness compilation pipeline for Hocus.
Conventional commits standards, atomic single-concern change discipline, and repository cleanliness.
Atomic conventions, templates (incantations), lifecycle triggers (wards), and stop conditions (curses).
Testing standards, isolated filesystem fixtures, child process mocking, and Ink TUI testing practices.
Guidelines for token optimization, RTK shell command proxying, and Graphify knowledge graph queries.
Best practices for React 19 and Ink terminal UI development, styling with picocolors, and ASCII fallback rendering.
TypeScript guidelines, strict ESM import paths with .js extensions, and build verification for Hocus.
